name: gha-indie-worker-infra

ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained GitHub token with read-only Contents access limited to private ORESoftware/ores-cli, ORESoftware/ores-compose, and ORESoftware/codespaces-cluster for Codespace bootstrap only.

TUNNEL_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare named-tunnel connector token consumed by oresc codespace edge up.

postCreateCommand: bash -euc 'test -n "${ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN:-}" || { echo >&2 "ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN is required for private ORESoftware Codespace tooling"; exit 78; }; GH_TOKEN="$ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN" gh auth setup-git >/dev/null; GH_TOKEN="$ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN" gh repo view ORESoftware/codespaces-cluster --json name >/dev/null; if ! command -v oresc >/dev/null 2>&1; then GH_TOKEN="$ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN" CARGO_NET_GIT_FETCH_WITH_CLI=true cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/ORESoftware/ores-cli.git --rev d37aa4c1a0b79a292a31e2f16db8622144b0831f --bin oresc; fi; if ! command -v ores-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then GH_TOKEN="$ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN" CARGO_NET_GIT_FETCH_WITH_CLI=true cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/ORESoftware/ores-compose.git --rev 9fbbaf4580b91c1445ec91f67ad3b31252094171 --bin ores-compose; fi; cargo run --locked --manifest-path tools/dev-runtime/Cargo.toml -- validate; just codespace-edge-check'
